title: iBOT
paper_title: iBOT: Image BERT Pre-Training with Online Tokenizer
core_mech: EMA teacher 同时充当在线视觉 tokenizer，以图像级 DINO 蒸馏和被遮 patch token 蒸馏联合训练。
core_mech_en: Uses the EMA teacher simultaneously as an online visual tokenizer to jointly distill masked patch tokens alongside global [CLS] self-distillation.
input_desc: 同一图像的多裁剪视图与随机遮蔽 patch
input_en: Multi-crop augmented views with random block-wise patch masking applied to the student
output_desc: 同时具备全局语义和局部 patch 语义的视觉表征
output_en: ViT representations capturing both global image semantics and fine-grained local patch semantics

source.title: iBOT
notes: The upstream repository is archived. Pin and isolate its legacy dependencies before attempting the original workflow.

adapter.name: iBOT
adapter.mechanism: Global distillation plus patch-token distillation from unmasked teacher to masked student.
limitations: Shared-head two-view mechanism exercise; simplified mask sampler/encoder and no original training schedule or weights.

verification.title: iBOT

limitations: Shared-head two-view mechanism exercise; simplified mask sampler/encoder and no original training schedule or weights.
